Plan your website

Tell me what you need

Answer a few questions about your business and the website you want. I’ll use your answers to recommend what to build and give you a quote.

Only four answers are required. You can review them before submitting the form. Leaving or refreshing this page clears your answers.

Questions or prefer to talk first? Message me on WhatsApp or email me.

Your business

A few basics to understand who the website is for.

Your trading name, or a working name.
Describe your products or services in a few sentences.
For example, families in Tampines or small business owners.
Locations served, or online only.

Contact details

Your reply details are for this enquiry. Tell me separately what should appear on the website.

The address I should reply to.
Public email, phone, preferred messaging platform, address, opening hours and social links. Only include what you want published.

What you need

No need to pick a package or a template. Describe the job and I’ll recommend an approach.

For example, enquire, book a session, browse listings or place an order.
For example, services, prices, about, gallery, FAQs and contact. Or write “please recommend”.
Features you have in mind (optional)
What happens today, what should happen on the website, and any tools you already use? Features and integrations are quoted after review.

Content and design

Send what you have. If anything is missing, tell me what you need help with.

Add the main offerings, descriptions, prices and any important terms.
Why should someone choose you? Include testimonials only if you have permission to publish them.
Paste links to any files you want to share, such as your logo or photos.
Brand colours, websites you like, what you like about them, and anything to avoid. No template choice needed.

Timing and setup

Rough answers are fine. I’ll use them to prepare a quote.

Any existing website URL, domain name or hosting? Say what you already own, or ask for help. Do not include passwords or access codes.
Optional. “Please recommend” is fine.
A date or rough timeframe, and whether it’s flexible.
Special requirements, accessibility needs, multiple languages or questions for me.

Review and submit

Check your answers below, then select Submit to send them to SumoSites.
